description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2530014729842 STEERING GEAR,MITER: Line 0001 Qty 110 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0284 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 16. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 75Q65 3340967; 78222 M100PNB1; 78222 M100PWR1. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
